entries.label: MGS1 — Underground Passage / premier duel Sniper Wolf
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE empty 2D fighting-game stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, wide landscape 16:9. This is an accurate painted-HD adaptation of Metal Gear Solid 1 (1998 PlayStation original), NOT the Twin Snakes remake. Inspect and follow the attached original-game reference for architecture, colors, materials and identifying layout. Remove all people, vehicles, HUD, text, logos, annotation arrows and map markers. No collage, no labels, no watermark. Keep a continuous horizontal combat floor across the lower quarter and a coherent readable background. No fake layer split, no spritesheet, no UI. Preserve the reference's distinctive shapes rather than replacing the location with a generic military room. LOCATION Underground Passage before the first Sniper Wolf duel. Preserve the reference's exceptionally long, narrow, straight grey-green concrete corridor, continuous low floor-edge lamps, tall damp plain concrete side walls, thin pipes near the base and high along the wall, rear communications tower metal facade and elevated shooting balcony with a central square column and a short stair at the right. Compose for a 2D fight with a broad horizontal foreground concrete lane while the characteristic long sniper alley recedes down the center of the background to that raised grey industrial balcony. Cold green-white practical lighting, no snowfield or trees, no fantasy bunker embellishments. NO people, sniper, bodies, footprints, guns, HUD, map labels, UI or text. Exact PS1 architecture translated into painted HD.

notes: Identity, original edition, palette and defining structures checked against the listed game screenshots.
Wide painted combat view includes composition and hidden-detail adaptation; strict 1:1 certification remains pending.
Static source only; not admitted to runtime, no animated layers or collision geometry.
